other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage via group aggregations before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes group-level aggregations (e.g., means) and frequency encodings on the combined training and test datasets before splitting. This leaks information about the test distribution into the training features, leading to overly optimistic validation scores and potential overfitting.

summary: The agent builds a well-structured pipeline with extensive feature engineering and cross-validated ensembles of LightGBM and XGBoost. However, the solution suffers from critical data leakage because imputation, PCA/SVD dimensionality reduction, and group aggregations are all computed on the combined train and test datasets before splitting. Furthermore, the ensembling strategy is naive, relying on a hardcoded 50/50 split rather than optimized weights.
